name: Shanghai Golden Union Business Management Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Golden Union Business Management Co., Ltd. specializes in the acquisition, operation, and stewardship of commercial real estate across China. The company's activities encompass the refurbishment and modernization of aging buildings, alongside the repositioning, redesign, and redevelopment of dated urban and underperforming commercial assets. It also prioritizes enhancing asset worth and conducting strategic industry analysis to foster local economic evolution and growth. Established in 2007, the firm maintains its principal office in Shanghai, China.
